title: Full Audit Log Implementation
description: Make the Audit Log page show ALL significant system operations (jobs, workflows, runs, policy, packs, config, schemas, DLQ, users) — not just policy publish/rollback. Extends the existing policyAuditEntry struct with resource_type/resource_id, adds a convenience helper, instruments ~23 handlers, and updates the dashboard.
architectureNotes: Backend: Extend policyAuditEntry struct in policy_bundles.go with ResourceType and ResourceID fields. Add appendAuditEntry convenience helper. Instrument all state-changing HTTP handlers across gateway.go, policy_bundles.go, packs.go, and auth_handlers.go. Increase audit cap from 100 to 500. Dashboard: Update PolicyAuditEntry type and AuditLogPage component with resource_type badge, resource_id display, and expanded action color mapping.
epicRails: Do not break existing policy audit entries — new fields are omitempty
Audit calls must go BEFORE the success response write, not after
Use policyActorID(r) and policyRole(r) consistently for all entries
